<thought>We have a 1H NMR showing only aromatic protons (5 H total) typical of a monosubstituted benzene. No aliphatic protons are present, suggesting the rest of the molecule contains only heteroatoms or unsaturated carbons without attached hydrogens (e.g., carbonyl, nitrile, aromatic carbonyl, etc.). To narrow down the structure, we need additional data: 13C NMR, IR, and mass spectrum. I will first request the 13C NMR.</thought>
